parameters.description:
Aggressiveness parameter for the passive-aggressive algorithm, see [1].
For PA-I it is the maximum step size. For PA-II it regularizes the
step size (the smaller `C` the more it regularizes).
As a general rule-of-thumb, `C` should be small when the data is noisy.
parameters.name: C

parameters.description:
Whether the intercept should be estimated or not. If False, the
data is assumed to be already centered. Defaults to True.
parameters.name: fit_intercept

parameters.description:
The maximum number of passes over the training data (aka epochs).
It only impacts the behavior in the ``fit`` method, and not the
:meth:`~sklearn.linear_model.PassiveAggressiveRegressor.partial_fit` method.

.. versionadded:: 0.19
parameters.name: max_iter

parameters.description:
The stopping criterion. If it is not None, the iterations will stop
when (loss > previous_loss - tol).

.. versionadded:: 0.19
parameters.name: tol

parameters.description:
Whether to use early stopping to terminate training when validation.
score is not improving. If set to True, it will automatically set aside
a fraction of training data as validation and terminate
training when validation score is not improving by at least tol for
n_iter_no_change consecutive epochs.

.. versionadded:: 0.20
parameters.name: early_stopping

parameters.description:
The proportion of training data to set aside as validation set for
early stopping. Must be between 0 and 1.
Only used if early_stopping is True.

.. versionadded:: 0.20
parameters.name: validation_fraction

parameters.description:
Number of iterations with no improvement to wait before early stopping.

.. versionadded:: 0.20
parameters.name: n_iter_no_change

parameters.description: Whether or not the training data should be shuffled after each epoch.
parameters.name: shuffle

parameters.description:
The loss function to be used:
epsilon_insensitive: equivalent to PA-I in the reference paper.
squared_epsilon_insensitive: equivalent to PA-II in the reference
paper.
parameters.name: loss

parameters.description:
If the difference between the current prediction and the correct label
is below this threshold, the model is not updated.
parameters.name: epsilon

parameters.description:
Used to shuffle the training data, when ``shuffle`` is set to
``True``. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple
function calls.
See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
parameters.name: random_state

parameters.description:
When set to True, reuse the solution of the previous call to fit as
initialization, otherwise, just erase the previous solution.
See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`.

Repeatedly calling fit or partial_fit when warm_start is True can
result in a different solution than when calling fit a single time
because of the way the data is shuffled.
parameters.name: warm_start

parameters.description:
When set to True, computes the averaged SGD weights and stores the
result in the ``coef_`` attribute. If set to an int greater than 1,
averaging will begin once the total number of samples seen reaches
average. So average=10 will begin averaging after seeing 10 samples.

.. versionadded:: 0.19
   parameter *average* to use weights averaging in SGD.
parameters.name: average
